character: Anti-clockwise circuit with dramatic elevation changes packed into a short lap. Bumpy surface and unpredictable weather make it a driver favourite. Flows well but punishes hesitation.
sources: https://www.formula1.com/en/racing/2026/brazil/circuit official F1 circuit guide; Senna S/Ferradura/Junção/Subida dos Boxes naming long-established

corners.name: Senna S
corners.technique: Brake on the downhill approach, commit through the direction change without over-slowing
corners.trap: Braking too late on the downhill and running wide at the second part

corners.name: Descida do Lago
corners.technique: Carry speed downhill with smooth steering, trust the grip
corners.trap: Lifting unnecessarily on the downhill kills momentum

corners.name: Ferradura
corners.technique: Patient, progressive line as the corner tightens, don't apex too early
corners.trap: Early apex leaves nowhere to go as the corner keeps tightening

corners.name: Junção
corners.technique: Firm braking, late apex, prioritise a strong exit onto the following straight
corners.trap: Poor exit here costs significant time on the run back to the start/finish

corners.name: Subida dos Boxes
corners.type: final uphill corner onto the pit straight
corners.technique: Late apex, progressive throttle up the hill
corners.trap: Early throttle on the uphill exit causes wheelspin
